tools.name: compare_heloc_offers
tools.description: Compare a HELOC or home equity loan offer the homeowner already has (rate, points and closing costs) with our live quote for the same scenario. Shows upfront costs and estimated interest plus fees over 5 years for each. Uses only the numbers the homeowner provides for the other offer.

tools.name: compare_heloc_vs_refinance
tools.description: Compare keeping the current first mortgage and adding our live HELOC, versus replacing it with a cash-out refinance at a rate the homeowner was quoted.
